reviews.text:
Scam site? Zero stars an option?. I feel like this is a scam site. Over this last year that I’ve had the app, I’ve attempted to purchase tickets at the cheap price displayed. And every time I have clicked to make payment, the very next window shows an increased price. 

This is not because the prices go up immediately… because I had my wife then use her computer to go to the site/app and she would still see the lower price, therefore it’s not increased. It only increases once they know you’re interested in the flight and click to pay. As an example, a flight that was approximately $200 each. Once we put in our payment info and tried to pay, the total was just under $700… the flights that I’ve attempted to book all jumped in total price by 300% to 400%. 

Again, this site / app feels like a scam and I’m concerned with how they get your payment info and only then they give this highly inflated total. 

I have this app in my phone under the label of Scam. I won’t trust them and I’ve told others to stay away from it. Use at your own risk.

reviews.text: No good. I downloaded this app to expedite buying an inexpensive plane ticket for my step son to come visit. Note that he is an Un accompanied minor. We found the flight that we wanted and made sure we specified his age. Everything was confirmed. About a week later we received an email (from a third part travel agency that cheap flight uses I guess) saying that he could not fly because of his age. I asked if they could do anything about it otherwise they could just refund us (we also purchased their insurance). They said they would figure it out within 24 hours and get back to us. A few days later I received an email saying that his flight has been confirmed and everything is good to go. The day of the flight my step son got to the airport to check in and get his ticket but was told that the travel agency didn't pay for his ticket. I immediately called cheap flights who then directed me to the travel agency who then bounced me around to several different agents to whom I had to explain everything to each of them. Each agent had a different reason/ excuse on what happened. By this time he had already missed his flight. After getting nowhere with the agency (very rude demeanor with no apparent training for customer service), I called the airline directly. They explained that the travel agency (from cheap flights) had booked his flight with an airline that does not accept unaccompanied minors in error. After communicating this to the travel agency, they finally said that they would issue a refund and that they would call us within 24 hours to finalize that. This was 3 weeks ago and we haven't heard back from them. We are very disappointed that this type of company is even allowed to do business at all. So far, we feel ripped off and and now we have to wait to see our son :(.
